item.title: Ask HN: If you didn't know how to program, would you learn?
item.summary: As a contrived hypothetical, let's say you've suffered a head injury. When you wake up, everything is fine except you've completely forgotten all your skills related to writing software. Your knowledge of computers matches that of a layperson. Would you work to re-acquire those skills, or would you go do something else? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49347806 Points: 2 # Comments: 4
